provenance.note: stream-json output under -p needs --verbose; the probe is killed as soon as its system/init line arrives.
provenance.setting_sources: --setting-sources project is listed by --help; the value is parser-checked without a model call (2.1.273, 2026-09-23): `claude -p --setting-sources project --session-id bad -- x` reports the invalid session id, while `--setting-sources bogus` reports 'Invalid setting source'. Only the tree's .claude/settings.json (the hook pack's) loads; user and local settings do not.

hidden_flags.--max-turns: absent from --help; the parser accepts it (`claude -p --max-turns 1 < /dev/null` exits with the missing-input error, not 'unknown option', 2.1.273, 2026-09-23), but R-14.329 counts a flag --help does not list as unsupported: the probe omits it and a DriverDefaults.MaxTurns value refuses Spawn
hidden_flags.--append-system-prompt-file: absent as its own --help entry; --help names it in the --bare option text ('--append-system-prompt[-file]'), and the contract emits it from KernelPromptFile
hidden_flags.--append-subagent-system-prompt-file: absent from --help; the parser accepts it the same way, but R-14.329 counts it unsupported: a DriverDefaults.SubagentKernelPromptFile value refuses Spawn
